trust_decision.summary: The ZDR primitives decide whether a peer-supplied (decode) or caller-supplied (encode) length may be accepted against the caller's maxsize. At the pinned commit maxsize is accepted but never consulted, so a wire length larger than a caller buffer sized to maxsize is memcpy'd into it, and protocol limits (NFS4_FHSIZE, NFS4_OPAQUE_LIMIT, FHSIZE3, gids<16>) are not enforced.

landing_point.why: The summary names libnfs_zdr_bytes and an out-of-bounds write; the only write into caller storage is the memcpy into *bufp on decode.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API zdr_bytes/libnfs_zdr_bytes (include/nfsc/libnfs-zdr.h:246-247), reached by every generated opaque<N> decoder, e.g. nfs4/libnfs-raw-nfs4.c:350, nfs/libnfs-raw-nfs.c:58, mount/libnfs-raw-mount.c:44; decode and encode length checks
same zdr_bytes, decode into a caller-preallocated buffer (non-NULL *bufp)
public API zdr_string (include/nfsc/libnfs-zdr.h:278-279), e.g. nfs4/libnfs-raw-nfs4.c:233 machinename<255>, portmap/portmap.c:374
public API zdr_array (include/nfsc/libnfs-zdr.h:281-282), e.g. nfs4/libnfs-raw-nfs4.c:239 gids<16>

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed sites are in lib/libnfs-zdr.c; no second ZDR implementation exists in the tree (maxsize appears only in lib/libnfs-zdr.c and include/nfsc/libnfs-zdr.h outside generated code).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report leads to the memcpy in zdr_bytes, so a solver could argue that zdr_string and zdr_array allocate their own storage (lib/libnfs-zdr.c:401, lib/libnfs-zdr.c:439) and cannot overflow, and that encode-side limits are only protocol conformance, not memory safety.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The AUTH credential and verifier decoders pass the live oa_length as maxsize, and callers zero the rpc_msg first, so maxsize is 0 on decode. 0 (and ~0 from rpcgen) must remain 'unlimited' for the aliasing path. A plain `size > maxsize` check rejects every RPC call or reply that carries a non-empty cred or verf. The exception: a preallocated copy with maxsize 0 must accept only an empty field.

O6_input_shapes: opaque<N> decode into a preallocated buffer (memcpy path)
opaque<N> decode as an alias into the receive buffer (*bufp NULL)
opaque encode with an oversize caller length
array<N> decode count and encode count
maxsize sentinels 0 and ~0 treated as unlimited

O7_producer.where: The limits come from rpcgen-generated constants in the .x-derived decoders (e.g. nfs4/libnfs-raw-nfs4.c:350). The check lives in the primitive that consumes them; no separate producer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a variable-length opaque helper built on libnfs_zdr_opaque that reads a wire length and copies into a fixed caller buffer without consulting a limit
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: libnfs_zdr_opaque is already the copy primitive behind zdr_string (lib/libnfs-zdr.c:406). A maintainer adding a 'decode into my buffer' convenience would naturally wrap it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: GSS init response handle copied into a fixed-size rpc->context array sized to an assumed handle limit instead of malloc(handle_len)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The handle is decoded with maxsize ~0 (nfs4/libnfs-raw-nfs4.c:4275) and copied right after. A fixed context buffer is a plausible earlier design, and it sits in a different file from the ZDR primitives.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: hand-maintained rpcgen-style decoder that decodes a bounded field into a struct-embedded char array
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file is a hand-copied rpcgen output outside the generated protocol dirs, so a bounded-array variant would bypass the primitive's check while looking generated.

O9_family: memory safety: out-of-bounds write (length vs declared bound in XDR decoder)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/prog_zdr_bytes_zero.c and tests/prog_zdr_alignment.c are standalone ZDR unit programs linked against libnfs. The fix adds tests/prog_zdr_maxsize.c in the same style. No server is needed.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if (*size > maxsize) return FALSE;` before the memcpy in zdr_bytes only. This misses string, array and encode. Applied everywhere, it breaks the AUTH cred/verf decode that passes maxsize 0.

out_of_scope_notes: README.security-scan documents earlier, separately fixed ZDR findings (signed cast, zdr_malloc overflow, READDIR recursion, mTLS downgrade); not pursued.
The fix's test also covers a high-bit string length against the (int) cast at lib/libnfs-zdr.c:379; it is described there as a separate bug.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); tiny_repo not assessed.

Did not exhaustively confirm that no generated or hand-written decoder presets a non-NULL *bufp before decode at the pinned commit. A search of lib/*.c showed only encode-side presets (e.g. lib/nfs_v4.c:1006, lib/nfs_v4.c:1058).
Whether zdr_decode_buf is zeroed before generated decoders run (lib/pdu.c:1032-1035) was not read in full.
